# Safety Sphere Solution

> Leading Fire Safety, Electrical & Fire Compliance Audits, EHS, Construction HSE, ESG, Physical Security & Life Safety, and Digital Safety consulting company in India.

## About

Safety Sphere Solution delivers 360° industrial safety solutions across Fire Protection Engineering, Electrical & Fire Compliance Audits, Environment Health & Safety, Construction HSE Management, ESG, Physical Security & Life Safety, Digital Safety, AI monitoring, and professional training.

Primary locations: Nagpur (Maharashtra) and Raipur (Chhattisgarh), serving clients pan-India.

## Core Services

- [Fire Safety Engineering](https://safetyspheresolution.vercel.app/services/fire-safety-engineering): Fire compliance audits, Fire NOC, addressable alarms, VESDA/ASD, hydrant/sprinkler, foam, CO₂, water mist, design, installation, AMC
- [Electrical & Fire Compliance Audits](https://safetyspheresolution.vercel.app/services/electrical-fire-compliance-audits): Electrical audits, thermography, arc flash, power quality, fire load, lightning protection, rectification BOQ
- [EHS Engineering & Consulting](https://safetyspheresolution.vercel.app/services/ehs-engineering): EIA, HAZOP, COSHH, ESG, LOTO, HIRA, JSA, chemical safety, emergency planning
- [Construction HSE Management](https://safetyspheresolution.vercel.app/services/construction-hse): HSE plans, contractor audits, permits, scaffold/crane coordination, site induction, documentation
- [Professional EHS Training](https://safetyspheresolution.vercel.app/services/ehs-training): Fire fighting, first aid/CPR, height, electrical, LOTO, confined space, BBS, leadership
- [Digital Automation & AI](https://safetyspheresolution.vercel.app/services/digital-ai): AI cameras, e-PTW, digital LOTO, IoT detection, dashboards, remote monitoring readiness
- [Safety Consultancy & Audits](https://safetyspheresolution.vercel.app/services/safety-consultancy): ISO consulting, TVRA-aligned assessments, facility audits, BCP and crisis drills
- [Physical Security & Life Safety](https://safetyspheresolution.vercel.app/services/physical-security-life-safety): Access control gaps, CCTV blind spots, fire-life safety, evacuation and crisis readiness
